root.label: DOE employee Ashton Ellaboudy arrested and charged with attempting to aid Houthis

events.label: DOE employee Ashton Ellaboudy arrested and charged with attempting to aid Houthis

slots.name: age
slots.sentence: Ashton Hamed Ellaboudy, 51, of Richland, Wash., was charged with “attempting to provide material support or resources to the Houthis” after he tried to help the group improve its communications capabilities, purchased materials for homemade explosives and drones and even traveled to Yemen, the department said.

slots.name: maximum penalty
slots.sentence: "This matter did not involve an attempt to harm the Hanford Site or its workforce, and at no time was there a threat to the safety or security of the site," said Ray Geimer, office manager of the Department of Energy Hanford Field Office.

slots.name: site threat status
slots.sentence: The DOE stressed that Ellaboudy did not attempt to harm the Hanford site or its workforce and at no time was there a threat to the safety or security of the location.

slots.name: maximum prison term
slots.sentence: If convicted, he faces a maximum penalty of 20 years in prison.

slots.name: maximum prison sentence
slots.sentence: Ellaboudy faces a maximum penalty of 20 years in prison if convicted.
